lanes.name: t1-sink-terminal-handoff
lanes.derivation: Measured on t1-s1-shadow-journal commit c94ebc3715f7a898e61d8bdea6ed7cfef665e581 with cargo test --lib services::discord::session_relay_sink -- --list; 105 named tests were selected. This branch contains the DeliveryJournal single-writer contract: pg_store.rs exposes the raw append entry point only within the journal module, check_delivery_journal_raw_writer.py enforces its exact allowlist, and ci-script-checks.sh runs that gate.
